summary: The change bounds terminal mapping retirement to four attempts, removes the pending marker after exhaustion, and adds a regression test proving an already-upgraded sideband receives the 1011 close when KV deletion keeps failing. No actionable defect was found.

evidence: src/live/upstream.ts:29-30 defines a four-attempt retirement bound.
src/live/upstream.ts:177-192 retries only within that bound and always releases the pending retirement marker in finally.
tests/live-sideband-http.test.ts:747-759 adds a regression test with infinite delete failures and asserts the sideband receives the 1011 failure close.
